summary.intent: Merge origin/main into the phase-44 branch (IPNS conflict handling), then execute the full GSD ship workflow to create a PR and track the milestone completion.
summary.outcome: Successfully merged origin/main (28 conflicts resolved, TypeScript + Rust compile clean), created PR #488, and fixed a stale SDK test surfaced by CI — though the Release Preview required check was still failing at transcript end due to two non-conventional commit messages from earlier phase work.

repo: Repo is squash-only (PR_TITLE becomes commit subject on main), so 124-commit history with cosmetic phase-42/43 commits is harmless — they collapse on merge.
required_signatures is false — history rewrites without re-signing are permitted.

Release Preview job (.github/scripts/pr-release-preview.js) enforces conventional-commit format on every individual commit touching a versioned package, not just the PR title — exit 1 makes it a required-to-merge check.
The `release:none` label escape hatch cancels all version bumps for the PR entirely — wrong for a real feature, only use for pure docs/chore PRs.
Repo uses Entire-Checkpoint: trailers instead of gate_status: trailers, so the GSD TDD-audit table would produce 124 all-missing rows (noise); replaced with a transparency note.
CI enforces conventional-commit PR titles via pr-title.yml — the GSD workflow's default 'Phase 44: ...' title would have been rejected.
Bot pushes to the branch between local commits are a known gotcha; fetch before pushing to avoid non-fast-forward failures.
Pre-push hook syncs an Entire-checkpoint; pre-commit runs eslint/prettier/markdownlint and folds auto-fixes into the commit.
1Password SSH signing requires unsandboxed Bash — the sandboxed environment hangs on commit.
The gsd commit helper reports commit_failed as a known false negative; always verify via git log rather than trusting the helper exit status.

code.finding: Stale assertion: test still expected batchPublishIpnsRecords to be called directly, but phase-44 Plan-03 moved IPNS publishing inside updateFileMetadata (CAS path), so updateSharedFile no longer calls it. The assertion at line 347 (updateFileMetadata was called) already covers the publish step.
Comment documents the architectural change: updateFileMetadata now publishes internally with CAS; the separate batchPublishIpnsRecords call was removed from updateSharedFile to avoid double-publish.

origin/main's guardedUnpin is a strict superset of this branch's version — adds suppressCrossUserAudit option and inline lock computation. Pattern: phase-42/43 implementations were refined on their dedicated PR branches before merging to main, leaving this branch with older divergent copies.

workflow: When a long-running branch carries sequential implementation of multiple phases and those earlier phases have since landed on main via separate PRs, resolve all conflicts for the already-merged phases by taking main's versions wholesale — verify zero overlap with the current phase's file footprint before applying.
Delegate verbose typecheck/cargo-check runs to a sub-agent to keep the main context window clean; return only pass/fail + errors.
Verify compilation after a complex merge before committing — the merge commit itself should be clean.
Phase verification running only the sub-package test suite (sdk-core) rather than the full monorepo suite can miss stale tests in dependent packages (sdk) that import the refactored code.

friction: Transient git index.lock collision mid-conflict-resolution blocked two files (commands/sync.rs, fuse/mod.rs) — required a lock check and retry.
gsd commit helper false-negative on commit_failed requires verifying every commit via git log rather than trusting the helper, adding an extra verification step each time.

The ship workflow's default PR title format ('Phase 44: ...') would have been rejected by the repo's CI conventional-commit enforcement — required a judgment call deviation from the workflow template.

Two early phase-44 commits used 'feat 44-02:' / 'test 44-02:' (space instead of scope parens), which passed local hooks but triggered the Release Preview required check — a latent issue that only surfaced at PR creation.
Phase-44 verification was run against sdk-core only; the full packages/sdk test suite wasn't run, allowing a stale test to reach CI undetected.
open_items: Release Preview required check still failing at transcript end: commits b433553b6 ('feat 44-02:') and 0b826ca65 ('test 44-02:') have non-conventional subjects and touch packages/sdk-core. Fixing requires either a history rewrite (force-push) or accepting the check failure.
PR #488 pending full CI pass (Lint, Detect Changes, Release Preview, and CodeRabbit auto-review all queued) before merge.
Run /gsd:complete-milestone after PR #488 merges — STATE.md already marks v1.1 milestone complete but the workflow step hasn't been executed.
Consider running full monorepo test suite (not just sub-package) as part of phase verification to catch stale tests in dependent packages earlier.
